    now = datetime.now()
    min_created_at = f"{now.year:04d}-{now.month:02d}-01"

    pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
    venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='angelica.wils@gmail.com', password=pw)
    venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']
    page_limit=20
    sent_transactions=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, direction='sent', min_created_at=min_created_at, max_created_at=max_created_at, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not res:
            break
        sent_transactions.extend(res)
        if len(res)<page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    recipient_emails=[]

        if isinstance(t.get('receiver'), dict):

            if e:
                recipient_emails.append(e)

    print('recomputed recipient_set', len(recipient_set))

page_limit=20

    res = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

        break
    for f in res:
        e=f.get('email')
        if e:
            final_friend_emails.append(e)
    if len(res)<page_limit:

    page_index+=1
